text:
Irene Park: Quick UX catch from onboarding: sidecar labels 'Dedicated pools' but the docs canonical page uses 'Capacity reservations'. This causes search mismatches and a couple of support tickets.

Jonas Reed: Can you paste the exact links? are they pointing to different paths?

Irene Park: Console sidecar links to /help/dedicated-pools while docs canonical is /docs/capacity-reservations. Also sidecar currently opens the docs anchor like /docs/capacity-reservations#limits but our redirector strips fragments so users land at top of page.

Felix Tran: Oof. Two parts: (1) pick a canonical term for docs, (2) add transitional copy in the sidecar to avoid breaking users, and (3) preserve fragments or add alias routes.

Maya Ortiz: UX proposal: docs canonical = 'Capacity reservations'. Sidecar label = 'Dedicated pools (Capacity reservations)' for two releases. Also change the CTA label to 'See capacity details (docs)' so it reads clearly.

Jonas Reed: Engineering: can the redirector be updated to preserve hash fragments when forwarding `/help/*` -> `/docs/*`? If we keep stripping, anchors are useless.

Docs Bot: link-checker: /help/dedicated-pools -> 302 -> /docs/capacity-reservations (fragment lost). Also /help/quickstart -> 404 (QA scan).

Felix Tran: I'll add an alias entry so /help/dedicated-pools resolves without redirect and I'll patch the redirector to preserve the hash fragment. Also will append utm_source=sidecar to the link for analytics.

Maya Ortiz: Accessibility: the sidecar's streaming example doesn't have aria-live. Add role="region" aria-live="polite" and an accessible name like "Help examples". Also the close control should be aria-label="Close help panel" and focus should return to the opener button.

Accessibility Bot: a11y-scan: missing aria-live on streaming content; close button lacks descriptive aria-label; focus-return untested.

Irene Park: Good catches. Small styling note: heading size in sidecar is 16px but Console headers are 20px; can we match Console tokens?

Felix Tran: I'll update the sidecar CSS tokens to match Console 20px header and ensure visited link color uses --link-visited token so contrast meets WCAG.

Jonas Reed: Action list: Felix 1 add alias + preserve fragments + utm param + adjust link resolver; Maya 1 update mock with transitional label, CTA copy, heading size, and ARIA text; Irene 1 open docs PR to canonicalize term and add small anchor ids for key sections; I'll add e2e tests for fragment landing and focus return.

Docs Bot: Created issue #5320: "Canonicalize term -> 'Capacity reservations'; add alias /help/dedicated-pools; preserve URL fragments; add quickstart redirect"

Irene Park: Thanks team  will follow up on PR links in this thread. Small UX wins but should cut a lot of friction for new users. :sparkles:
